new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Al Barsha?
Private dining in Al Barsha starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Al Barsha do you serve?
All of Al Barsha — Al Barsha 1, 2 and 3, Al Barsha South and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
Included is a vetted chef, service staff where needed, plating, setup and the cleanup — all handled for you. You provide the kitchen; the chef brings everything else.
How do I book?
Booking takes one message: share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can you cater a party or larger gathering?
Yes — al barsha party catering and dinner parties are among the most-booked formats here, served as a buffet, grazing table or plated menu scaled to your guest count.
Do you offer halal and dietary-specific menus in Al Barsha?

Every menu can be prepared fully halal. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Do you cover apartments as well as villas?
Yes — an in-villa chef al barsha works in both. Whether you host in an Al Barsha villa or an apartment tower, the chef adapts the menu and prep to your kitchen.
For private chef al barsha, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
